text:
alex: Heads-up — saw a regression on tail latency after yesterday's kernel-fallback change. It's subtle: overall throughput ok, but ~95th/99th for short prefill-heavy requests jumped ~18-25ms.

mira: ugh. Is that with the new fallback order or the token-budget tweak?

alex: fallback order + we rotated the token_budget target down for the prefill queue (to try to reduce gen contention). Suspect the warmup sampler is now coalescing different-phase requests into the same batch more often.

sam: I ran a quick synthetic repro. Prefill-only traffic (prompt len ~160) shows avg kv-warmup time up 10ms and decode-latency unaffected. When mixed (prefill+short-decode), decode p95 spikes. Logs: 

```
# simplified
2026-03-15T10:12:03Z INFO batch_coordinator: batch(id=842) phases=[prefill,decode] shape=[8x160]
2026-03-15T10:12:03Z DEBUG kernel_select: chose=fallback_kernel_a reason=latency_budget
2026-03-15T10:12:03Z INFO kv_cache: primed=8 entries priming_ms=11
2026-03-15T10:12:03Z WARN scheduler: handshake_delay=21ms cause=phase_mixing
```

sam: Repro command I used: `tools/loadtest --mix prefill:0.6,decode:0.4 --prompt-len 160 --concurrency 40 --duration 5m`

ian: My first thought: sampler cohorting. We currently bucket by model+route+priority but not by phase (prefill vs decode). When sampler sees many small decodes it tries to fill batches, and if a long prefill arrives it forces kernel path changes mid-batch. Splitting warmup buckets by phase should reduce kernel churn.

mira: Agreed. Also worth trying to raise prefill token_budget slightly for a short window so prefill gets dedicated micro-batches instead of being stitched into decode batches. That should reduce handshake delays.

perf-bot: profiler snapshot attached (brief):
- kernel-switch count (last 5m): 143 -> +42% vs baseline
- avg batch shape variance: 0.31 -> 0.48
- kv-priming ms p95: 18ms -> 28ms
- total tokens/sec: unchanged

perf-bot: heap of traces: /perf/5099990000/kernel-switch-traces-20260315.log (internal)

alex: Cool. Proposed plan:
1) Quick experiment: cohort warmup sampler by phase (prefill vs decode) + keep existing route buckets intact.
2) Ramp token_budget for prefill from 0.6 -> 0.75 of default for 10m as A/B.
3) Add a short-lived metric for "phase-mixed-batches" and alert if >0.5% of batches.
4) Re-run synthetic load test and prod canary.

sam: I'll spin up the experiment in staging. Quick patch to sampler (pseudo):

```
# sampler pseudocode
if request.phase == 'prefill': bucket_key += '|phase=prefill'
else: bucket_key += '|phase=decode'
enqueue(bucket_key, req)
```

sam: Also toggling token_budget via runtime flag: `rtcfg set route:prefill:token_budget=0.75`

ian: Another micro-optimization: when phase buckets are split, prioritize kv-priming for prefill (warm starting the cache) and set a soft delay-for-priming of ~3ms before handing off to decode kernel to avoid immediate kernel switch. That should smooth the handshake.

mira: We should confirm we don't regress cold-start throughput for low-concurrency workloads. Can we add a small AB in staging that records cold-start success rate and tail latency per-customer?

alex: Good call. Sam, please include per-customer tail metrics and the perf-bot trace link in the PR. I'll own the canary.

sam: ACK. Starting now — building patch and running `tools/loadtest --mix prefill:0.7,decode:0.3 --concurrency 80 --duration 10m` (higher conc to hit batcher). Will post results in this thread.

perf-bot: reminder: don't forget kernel bench: `bench/kernel_switch_ratio --model gpt-open-8b --shape 8x160` — useful to compare fallback_kernel_a vs kernel_b.

ian: If staging looks good, we should consider longer-term: make "phase" a first-class dimension in sampler + allow token_budget to be a function of recent phase-mix history (decay-based). But let's land the simple split first.

mira: timeline?

alex: Sam will run experiments today, we'll decide mid-day tomorrow. If green, small rollout to 10% traffic.

sam: Update (10m into staging run): mixed-run p95 decode latency down ~12ms vs before patch, prefill p95 unchanged. phase-mixed-batches metric dropped from 2.1% -> 0.12%. Uploading traces.

alex: 🎉 nice. Open PR link when ready and tag me + eng-runtime on the review.

mira: add a short note in the changelog about the token_budget tweak and the reason (phase coalescing).

ian: filing a follow-up ticket to track phase-aware token_budget strategies: INF-1428

alex: thanks team — nice quick win.
